sceneTimeline.narration: A lesson is not only a plan. It is the explanation, the visuals, the questions, the practice, and the next decision a teacher makes.
In EdulabsAI, the teacher starts with the curriculum, class, subject, topic, teaching approach, and available time—so generation begins with real classroom context.
The result is one connected package: an editable lesson plan, a visual slide deck, a quiz with explanations, and a differentiated worksheet—all aligned to the same objective.
Teachers can inspect quality evidence, make a targeted change with AI, and recover earlier versions. The system accelerates the work; the teacher remains the editor.
Export the lesson as editable PowerPoint, print-ready PDFs, answer keys, quality reports, or a school-format plan—ready for the tools teachers already use.
What begins as one clear teaching intention stays connected through presentation, practice, assessment, and the next better lesson.
Build your next classroom-ready lesson with EdulabsAI.
